video.title: Opening an OP-17 (The World's Strongest Warriors) One Piece Booster Box!
video.description:
Today I am cracking open my second booster box of the new set OP-17 (The World's Strongest Warriors). What was your favorite pull today? I wish you the best of luck in your pulls if you're able to find product and as always thanks for watching!
